findings.issue: אָדָם is a common noun (H120, Ncmsa), not a proper name; adam leaves the lemma untranslated.
Qal imperfect 3ms is smoothed to subjunctive toque; person and number stay.
Surface בַּ carries the article with the preposition; en traspasado leaves the adjective indefinite.
Qal imperfect 3ms licenses be or become unclean. se impurecerá is inchoative smoothing, and se can be read as a reflexive the qal does not mark.

notes: Y, todo, el que, sobre, plural faces, del campo, construct de espada, the three או, the participle muerto, construct hueso, sepulcro, and seven days match the tokens.
